integrity: An all-prime-power mathematical proof is given and independent exact small-field enumerations reproduced the formula. No independent audit or external validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Odd prime powers only, coordinate-marked coefficient classes; not a count up to projective isomorphism, not arbitrary (2,2) branch equations, no characteristic-two assertion. General all-q proof from involution and Gram-form counting, corroborated by exact finite checks. An unindexed equivalent mass formula remains possible.
title: Smooth Ciani quartics and diagonal conic-bundle presentations over finite fields
